test_eos_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset eos break mode that splits sequences at end-of-sequence tokens
test_block_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset block break mode that splits sequences into fixed-size blocks ignoring boundaries
test_complete_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset complete break mode that keeps sequences intact when they fit within block size
build_token_block_dataset: build a TokenBlockDataset from tensor data with configurable block size, pad, eos, and break mode
run_token_block_dataset_tests: run the unittest suite for TokenBlockDataset to verify all three break modes work correctly
